mission: Convert actionable DreamCo notes into structured implementation work so ideas do not remain stranded in Markdown, chat exports or planning files.
pipeline: extract headings, checkboxes and actionable statements
classify documentation vs idea vs bug vs capability vs benchmark gap vs architecture decision
search repository for existing implementation before creating work
generate code-change candidate or builder issue
only mark implemented when executable evidence exists
rules: Do not convert explanatory documentation into pointless code merely because it is a note.
Every actionable note must become either existing-code evidence, a deduplicated implementation candidate, or a clear blocked/rejected reason.
Search before building to avoid duplicate systems.
Notes describing shared fleet behavior should target shared infrastructure first.
High-risk or consequential capabilities require explicit review and guardrails before implementation.
A note is not complete because code was generated; tests and evidence must pass.
truth_rule: Notes-to-code means actionable notes are routed into executable implementation work. It does not mean every sentence or historical note should literally become source code.
